title: AGS 191 (BPI #4) soybean: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: AGS 191 (BPI #4) soybean is a vegetable soybean variety. About 70 days to harvest, 11.7 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: AGS 191 (BPI #4) soybean is a vegetable soybean variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 1996 as NSIC 1996 Sy 06. BPI Lbncrdc, Los Baños, Laguna bred it. It takes about 70 days from sowing to harvest, with 11.66 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

AGS 191 (BPI #4) soybean takes about 70 days from sowing to harvest. That is 12.6 days faster than the average of the 22 soybean varieties with a day count, 82.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 11.66 t/ha beats the average of its group, 2.94. It sits in the top quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit soybean fields most often: [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant AGS 191 (BPI #4) soybean

It is recommended for both the wet and the dry season. Grain soybean goes to feed and food processors, while vegetable soybean, or edamame, is picked green. Pick a variety rated against rust, the main soybean disease here.
